description: Which Swiss permit fits a person (the Swiss Living Index permit route finder as a tool): from nationality and plan (visit, work, commute from abroad, join family, study, retire, live without working, or already living here on a B permit) returns the permit (L, B, C, G or none), whether it is an entitlement or at the canton's discretion, the 2026 quota for non-EU work, every rule with its law article (AIG, VZAE, BüG) or SEM page, and for people already here the years until a C permit and naturalisation. Same logic as the page, checked by 45 test cases. Asylum statuses are out of scope. Information, not legal advice: the cantonal migration office decides.

family_member_in_switzerland.description: family: status of the person in Switzerland

family_member_is_eu_efta.description: family: that person is an EU/EFTA national (free movement rules, not covered)

job_length.description: work: under 3 months, 3 to 12 months, a year or longer / open-ended (default ge12)

nationality.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (e.g. DE, PL, GB, US, IN) or a group: eu5, eu, uk, other

qualified.description: work, non-EU: manager, specialist or other qualified worker (default true)

ties_to_switzerland.description: retire: earlier long stays or close relatives in Switzerland

years_on_b_permit.description: here: years on a B permit without interruption
